zh.title: 用 BrewReel 做第一支宣传片：先跑样例，再换成自己的产品
zh.description: 从本地依赖到样例出片，再到产品简报与发布检查。把环境是否可用、模型是否写对和成片是否能发布分开验证。
zh.body:
先理解三件事分别由谁完成

你提供简报和素材；语言模型按项目的配方写分镜 JSON；BrewReel 使用本地渲染程序生成视频。先跑仓库已有样例，可以在接入模型之前确认渲染环境是否可用。

cards 配方适合卖点和流程讲解，quiz 适合答题揭晓，journey 适合角色漫游。cards、quiz 默认 1080×1920，journey 默认 1080×1350。配方的可用状态与参数以仓库说明为准。

准备本地环境

当前项目 README 列出 Node.js 18+、Python 3.10+；项目记录了 Node 22 环境测试。DeepSeek Harness 插件的运行要求另列，不能直接套用普通脚本的要求。还需要 Git、npm 以及依赖下载空间。Windows 按项目说明使用 x64 环境。

1. 安装渲染依赖

git clone https://github.com/Finderchangchang/brewreel.git
cd brewreel/template
npm install
npx remotion browser ensure
cd ..
python -m pip install numpy scipy

如果系统只提供 python3 命令，把最后一行改成 python3 -m pip install numpy scipy。以上命令依次安装渲染组件、下载无头浏览器、安装配乐依赖。浏览器下载失败时先检查网络和项目的本地浏览器配置说明，不要把它当作分镜问题。

2. 校验并渲染仓库样例

node scripts/validate.mjs examples/ledger.json
node scripts/make.mjs examples/ledger.json --out ../brewreel-out/ledger

在 brewreel 仓库根目录执行。输出目录放在仓库外。静态校验通过只说明样例满足校验规则；还要让实际渲染完成，才能检查视频和交付文件。

按项目 README，输出包括 video.mp4、sheet.png、check/、report.txt 和 manifest.json。打开视频看完整片，查看检查报告，并核对清单中的分镜与本次任务一致。

3. 换成你的产品简报

把产品名、目标用户、核心动作、卖点、事实来源、素材和获取方式写清楚，再让模型按项目 SKILL 与所选行业配方生成分镜。可以从产品简报模板指南开始。没有的数据写「无」，不要让模型补出看似真实的效果数字。

生成分镜后重复「校验 → 渲染 → 看成片」，把报错和人工发现的问题反馈到分镜。模型调用与可选语音服务可能另收费。

4. 发布前逐项检查

  • 产品名、功能、价格和适用条件是否与简报一致。
  • 字幕是否能读清，旁白是否自然，音乐是否压过人声。
  • 实拍、截图和插画的来源与标注是否正确。
  • 片尾获取方式是否真实可用，有没有编造渠道。
  • 是否已按发布平台要求处理 AI 内容标识。

项目校验帮助发现部分问题，不能代替人工验片或正式业务审核。样片能渲染，不等于已经适合客户直接发布。

查看项目和依赖各自的许可

BrewReel 采用 Apache-2.0；再分发和二次开发需按项目 LICENSE、NOTICE 保留相应信息。渲染的视频不要求项目署名。Remotion 有独立许可，4 人及以上的营利组织需购买 Company License，详见官方许可。

这是按公开 README 编写的起步流程，本次网站更新没有重新渲染或评测样片。命令、已知限制和版本变化请核对 项目文档。
zh.cta: 先跑通仓库样例，再用自己的简报做一版可审查的初稿。

en.title: Make your first BrewReel promo video: run a sample, then use your own product
en.description: Set up the local renderer, validate and render an existing storyboard, then move to a product brief and a human review before publishing.
en.body:
Understand who does each part

You supply a brief and assets. A language model writes storyboard JSON using the project’s recipes. BrewReel renders the video locally with code. Running an existing sample first helps verify the renderer before introducing model-generated storyboards.

The cards recipe presents features and processes, quiz handles question-and-reveal sequences, and journey follows a character through a scene. Cards and quiz default to 1080×1920; journey defaults to 1080×1350. Check the repository for available recipes and parameters.

Prepare the local environment

The current README lists Node.js 18+ and Python 3.10+, and records testing with Node 22. The DeepSeek Harness plugin has separate runtime requirements. You also need Git, npm and space for dependencies. Follow the project’s x64 requirements on Windows.

1. Install rendering dependencies

git clone https://github.com/Finderchangchang/brewreel.git
cd brewreel/template
npm install
npx remotion browser ensure
cd ..
python -m pip install numpy scipy

If your system only provides python3, use python3 -m pip install numpy scipy for the last line. These commands install rendering components, download a headless browser and install music-generation dependencies. If the browser download fails, inspect network access and the project’s local-browser instructions before changing the storyboard.

2. Validate and render a repository sample

node scripts/validate.mjs examples/ledger.json
node scripts/make.mjs examples/ledger.json --out ../brewreel-out/ledger

Run these from the repository root and keep the output directory outside it. Passing static validation establishes that the storyboard meets validation rules. Complete a render before checking the actual video and delivery files.

The README describes video.mp4, sheet.png, check/, report.txt and manifest.json in the output. Watch the complete video, inspect the report and confirm the manifest corresponds to your storyboard.

3. Replace the sample with your product brief

Specify the product name, audience, core action, features, evidence, assets and acquisition route. Ask the model to follow the project SKILL and the selected industry recipe. Start with the product brief guide. Mark missing facts as unknown instead of letting the model invent performance figures.

Repeat validation, rendering and review. Use validator errors and human observations to revise the storyboard. Model calls and optional voiceover services may incur separate fees.

4. Review before publishing

  • Check product names, features, prices and conditions against the brief.
  • Check readable subtitles, natural narration and the music-to-voice balance.
  • Confirm permissions and labels for real photos, screenshots and illustrations.
  • Verify that the closing call to action uses a real acquisition route.
  • Apply AI-content labels required by the publishing platform.

Automated checks catch some issues; they do not replace watching the video or reviewing its business claims. A rendered sample is not automatically ready for a customer to publish.

Check both project and dependency licenses

BrewReel uses Apache-2.0. Follow LICENSE and NOTICE requirements when redistributing or modifying the project. Rendered videos do not require project attribution. Remotion has its own license; for-profit organizations with four or more employees need a Company License. See the official terms.

This guide follows the public README. The website update did not independently rerender or benchmark these samples. Check the repository for commands, limitations and version changes.
en.cta: Render an existing sample first, then use your brief to make a draft you can review.

zh.title: AI 宣传片产品简报怎么写：可下载模板与餐饮示例
zh.description: 把卖什么、给谁看、真实卖点、价格条件和素材来源写清楚。提供空白 Markdown 模板和明确标为虚构的餐饮示例。
zh.body:
先拿一份能填的模板

下载空白产品简报模板（Markdown） · 下载虚构餐饮示例

这些文件用普通文本编辑器就能填写。填完交给模型时，同时提供 BrewReel 的 SKILL 和对应行业配方；模板本身不是可直接渲染的分镜 JSON。

1. 写清楚观众应该理解的动作

不要只写「做一个高级的宣传片」。先写观众是谁、遇到什么问题，以及「用户做什么 → 产品给出什么」。软件可以描述一次具体操作；门店可以描述一次真实可提供的服务。

例如虚构餐饮示例写「顾客到店点选简餐 → 店员按菜单提供餐食」。它没有宣称排队更短、出餐更快或销量更高，因为示例没有这些证据。

2. 每个数字都带来源和完整条件

价格、时间、人数、效果百分比不能只给一个裸数字。写明原话、来源和适用条件。信息缺失就标「待确认」，不要把演示数字包装成商家经营成果。

不够完整的输入应该补什么
套餐 29 元包含什么、适用时间、是否券后、是否要预约、有无加价
节省一半时间测量对象、样本、时间段、对照方式和来源；没有就不写效果数字
顾客都说好获得使用许可的真实评价及出处；没有就不编评价

3. 素材说明要比文件名更清楚

给出文件、来源、使用授权、画面主体和希望突出的位置。门店照片与菜品照片可以标为商家实拍；软件截图是截图；插画和 AI 图片按实际性质说明，不能标成实拍。

没有照片时直接写「无」。BrewReel 可以按配方使用组件或插画兜底，但发布前仍要核对它是否会让观众误以为看到了真实商品或门店。

4. 片尾只放确实存在的获取方式

填写真实可用的行动入口，例如前往已上线官网、查看 GitHub 项目，或到实际存在的门店。未上线的渠道不要让模型补写；不知道就写「无」。

5. 交给模型前做一次自查

  1. 每个卖点都来自你提供的材料。
  2. 数字和条件没有彼此冲突。
  3. 虚构或演示数据已明确标注。
  4. 素材来源与可用范围可核对。
  5. 缺失信息写成「待确认」或「无」。

然后让模型生成分镜，运行项目校验，再渲染并人工看完整片。模板提高信息完整性，不代表获得平台审核或法律合规结论。

餐饮示例用于演示填写方法，店名、情境和内容都是虚构的，没有可对外出售的套餐。真实项目请以商家材料替换。字段依据：通用简报和餐饮简报。
zh.cta: 准备好简报后，按项目文档选择配方并生成可检查的分镜。

en.title: Write a product brief for an AI promo video: template and fictional café example
en.description: Specify the audience, product action, supported claims, price conditions and asset sources. Download a blank Markdown brief and a clearly fictional example.
en.body:
Start with a template you can fill in

Download the blank product brief (Markdown) · Download the fictional café example

Edit these files in a text editor. Supply the BrewReel SKILL and the relevant industry recipe when giving the brief to a model. The brief is not renderable storyboard JSON.

1. Describe the action the audience should understand

Go beyond “make a premium promo.” Identify the audience, the problem and the sequence “the user does this → the product delivers that.” For software, describe an actual operation. For a shop, describe a service it can really provide.

Our fictional café example describes a customer choosing a meal and staff serving it according to the menu. It does not claim shorter queues, faster service or higher sales because the example contains no such evidence.

2. Attach sources and conditions to figures

A price, duration, headcount or performance percentage needs context. Include the original claim, source and conditions. Mark missing information as unconfirmed; demonstration figures are not business results.

Incomplete inputWhat to add
A 29-unit meal dealCurrency, contents, dates, voucher conditions, reservations and surcharges
Saves half the timeSample, measurement period, comparison and evidence; omit the figure without support
Customers love itReal reviews with sources and permission; do not invent testimonials

3. Explain assets beyond their filenames

Provide the file, source, usage permission, subject and intended focus. Merchant photos are real photos; interface captures are screenshots; illustrations and AI images should be described accurately rather than labeled as photography.

Write “none” if photos are unavailable. Recipes can use components or illustrations as a fallback, but review whether the result could mislead viewers about the actual product or location.

4. Use a real acquisition route in the closing frame

Specify an available action such as visiting a published website, opening the GitHub project or going to an existing shop. Do not ask the model to invent a channel. Write “none” if the route is unknown.

5. Review the brief before handing it over

  1. Every feature claim is supported by supplied material.
  2. Figures and conditions are consistent.
  3. Fictional and demonstration data are labeled.
  4. Asset sources and usage rights can be checked.
  5. Missing information is marked as unconfirmed or absent.

Next, generate a storyboard, validate it, render it and review the full video. A complete brief does not establish legal compliance or guarantee platform approval.

The café example is entirely fictional and does not advertise an actual meal deal. Replace it with verified business information. Sources: the general brief and food-industry brief.
en.cta: Once the brief is ready, use the project documentation to select a recipe and create a reviewable storyboard.
